notes.title: Pretty Girls Mahjong Puzzle Bundle Out now!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26502074/2c5bfbf2115e682b8086b49a964cd8e6c1c3ff5d.png

Thank you for always playing "Pretty Girls" series!
We are pleased to inform you that we have released a great bundle pack.

This bundle pack includes popular games from the Pretty Girls series.
Let's enjoy the mahjong puzzle games as much as you want with cute beautiful girls!

◆Pretty Girls Mahjong Puzzle Bundle
Titles included in the bundle:

Pretty Girls Tile Match
Pretty Girls Rivers (Shisen-Sho)
Pretty Girls Mahjong Solitaire [RED]
Delicious! Pretty Girls Mahjong Solitaire

You can get a 30% bundle discount on this bundle pack.

For details, please check here.

We look forward to working with you in the future.

notes.title: Update [ver1.0.3]
notes.content:
*Added piece drawing in 2D or 3D switching function 
  (Fixed problem that tiles not appear in a part of PC that has low video card. )

The above is additional mainly for a part of PC that has low video card. 
If the tiles not drawn in 3D, try playing in 2D. 
(to be selected "2D or 3D" in option screen. )
